item.title: Free Naloxone Training for Lubbock community
item.description: LUBBOCK, Texas -- Lubbock Public Health's Prevention Resource Center, in partnership with Central Plains Center, will host a second free Naloxone (Narcan) training on Wednesday, March 4 begining at 6 p.m. at the Lubbock Public Health Building. item.title: One person arrested following a pursuit, crash in Central Lubbock
item.description: The Lubbock Police Department announced that one person is in custody following a pursuit that ended in a crash in Central Lubbock.

item.title: Brownfield resident dies in Terry County semi-trailer crash
item.description: The Texas Department of Public Safety announced that a Brownfield man was killed in a Tuesday morning crash in Terry County near US Highway 62, approximately half a mile southwest of County 515, according to a press release.

item.title: Texas Tech grad receives 30 Under 30 Award from alma mater
item.description: The first ever Davis College of Agriculture’s 30 Under 30 Awards have been selected. One of the recipients is Denny Atchley, a 2024 Summa Cum Laude graduate from Texas Tech.

item.title: Wolfforth Farmer's Market's Sunday evening market to come in March
item.description: There will soon be more activities and events to do on Sundays, with Wolfforth's Farmer's Market to start a Sunday Market on March 8. This new market will run in addition to their year-round Saturday Market and will begin at 4 p.m. and go through 7 p.m.

item.title: Early voting locations for Lubbock County March 2026 election
item.description: Early voting for the March primaries in Lubbock County, Texas begins on February 17, 2026, with 22 locations available for voters to cast their ballot.

item.title: Record breaking early voting turnout one week before election day
item.description: Early voting in Lubbock County, Texas has seen a 62% increase from 2024, with over 15,000 people casting their ballot in the first seven days, and a million Texans voting in the first week of primary elections.

item.title: Giles W. Dalby Unit celebrates grand opening after new ownership
item.description: The Giles W. Dalby Unit had a ribbon cutting on Tuesday to celebrate its doors opening again in Garza County.

item.title: Anderson keeps Texas Tech rolling in home victory over Cincinnati
item.description: No. 16 Texas Tech kept its foot on the gas following a huge win over K-State, as the Red Raiders rolled past Cincinnati 80-68 inside United Supermarkets Arena.
